headline: The 13th Amendment ends slavery
post_facts: Georgia was the 27th state to ratify

scenes.text: [solemnly] On this day, in eighteen sixty-five... slavery was abolished across the United States.

scenes.label: U.S. House, Jan. 31, 1865
scenes.caption: The House passes the amendment
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] That January, the House had passed the Thirteenth Amendment.

scenes.label: state to ratify: Georgia
scenes.text: [calmly] Then Georgia became the twenty-seventh state to ratify it... the final vote needed.

scenes.label: Emancipation
scenes.caption: Engraving by Thomas Nast, 1865
scenes.text: [warmly] Freedom was now written into the Constitution.

scenes.title: Lincoln never saw this day
scenes.text: [softly] Abraham Lincoln did not live to see this day.

scenes.title: Did you know it took this long?
scenes.text: [gently] Did you know it took this long to become law?
